gates.name: tools/Test-DesignState.ps1 (design state vs. tree)
gates.reason: pwsh -File tools/Test-DesignState.ps1 exited 2 (this script's own could-not-evaluate convention). It reported 42 blocking findings (UnrecordedArtifact) and 35 non-blocking reported items (MirrorStale/WorkStateDivergence), but its own output classifies the run as 'Could not evaluate (2): [ContractListUnreadable] ContractPathMissing: /Users/ben/Dropbox/Projects/SubZeroDev.Platform/design/20-contract.md' (twice, the second noting 'UnrecordedArtifact's invariant half is uncomputed, not clean'). design/20-contract.md does not exist in this branch (consistent with design/00-brief.md on this branch still being open on nine TODO sections per the latest commit), so the script cannot fully evaluate the design-state-vs-tree invariant and correctly refuses to report a clean pass or fail — exit code 2 per its documented DidNotRun/could-not-evaluate convention.
